canonical_project: Telecom Niue core network and government network services (incl. Alofi/Tuapa network sites)
owner: Telecom Niue Ltd (Government of Niue 100% SOE)
notes: Telecom Niue is the sole local fixed/mobile/internet operator (government-owned since 2016 corporatisation). Gov.nu 2026 release confirms ongoing island-wide fibre-optic network upgrades, two new network sites being deployed in Alofi and Tuapa, and continued repeater rollout; Telecom Niue also acts as project manager for government departments migrating to the new network. Operator/network lead (telecom_network_lead), NOT a datacenter - no public colocation/rack/data-centre service page verified.
